nodes.label: Item.custom_category (Ceramics / Home / Fashion = owning Sage company)
Item.custom_qty_pending_sage (Qty Added Locally (pending Sage))
nodes.rationale: While ticked the Sage QOH sync skips the item, otherwise target = sage_qty - other_warehouses would wipe locally-added stock within 5 minutes.

nodes.label: Company Sage Integration.custom_default_warehouse
nodes.rationale: The QOH sync skips an integration without it, so setting it to Main Distribution - A IS the sync switch-on; blanking it cuts training off from Sage.

nodes.label: Company Sage Integration.custom_last_qtyonhand_sync
nodes.rationale: QOH script only fetches items changed since this date; rewind it to force a re-pull; empty means the first FULL pull (zero-on-hand skipped).

nodes.label: Company Sage Integration.custom_last_inventory_sync
nodes.rationale: Date-only and advanced even when items error, so a failed day is lost unless rolled back.

nodes.label: Company Sage Integration.custom_sage_pos_sales_rep_id
nodes.rationale: Sage refuses a return without a sales rep.

nodes.label: Sales Invoice.custom_sage_sync_status
nodes.rationale: Set no_copy with the other Sage fields so a return no longer inherits the sale's 'Synced'.

nodes.label: Stock Entry.custom_stock_already_owned
nodes.rationale: Opening count loads are transfers out of Main Distribution of stock the entities already own, so they must not raise an intercompany invoice.

nodes.label: Importer Update Only switch (Custom Field update_only)
nodes.rationale: Blank cells are left alone so a cut-down corrections sheet cannot wipe good data; new items are not created and no stock moves.

nodes.label: TEST-only lock (SAGE_FORCE_COMPANY = Ardmore Ceramics TEST)
nodes.rationale: All tax invoices, returns and new items go to the Sage testing company until Russell lifts it; lift = blank SAGE_FORCE_COMPANY in three scripts together.

nodes.label: Training setup on Ardmore Ceramics TEST (TRAINING_COMPANIES guard, no Sage)
nodes.rationale: 'This is not UAT, this is training': Rule 1 = no Sage connection at all, so training sales are never posted nor flagged Failed.

nodes.label: Sage is master for stock
nodes.rationale: By design: sheet qty goes to Sage as QuantityOnHand and returns via the QOH sync as a Stock Reconciliation.

nodes.label: Shopify decision: no direct integration
nodes.rationale: Agreed with Jon Berning: a person manually re-captures each Shopify order on the Online till and ERPNext does the Sage functions; the human is the link.

nodes.label: POS switched to Sales Invoice mode
nodes.rationale: Till sales never reached Sage, so the QOH sync wrote every sale back into Main Distribution; a tax invoice per sale is mandatory for Ardmore.

nodes.label: Kiln sheet INCL VAT price rules
nodes.rationale: Retail lists held two VAT conventions at once (Sage ex-VAT vs importer incl-VAT); Russell's rule: the sheet's incl price rules, sync grosses up by 1.15.

nodes.label: Item_Cost is the sole authority for Valuation Rate
nodes.rationale: Sage was writing its own valuation_rate, sometimes the SELLING price, which valued stock at retail and gave zero margin.

nodes.label: Sage owns the price once the item exists (own-company rule)
nodes.rationale: The same item exists in all three Sage companies and each sync overwrote item-level fields, last company wins; now only the item's own company writes them.

nodes.label: Re-import rules (kiln never adds qty; Home/Fashion adds qty; price only on create)
nodes.rationale: There is only ever one piece of a ceramic, so a kiln re-import updates details only; a sheet cannot update an existing Sage item's price.

nodes.label: Go-live structure: one company Ardmore
nodes.rationale: One ERPNext company, Main Distribution fed by all three Sage companies, one till + warehouse per store, stock reaches a store only by transfer.

nodes.label: Instance cleaned for go-live
nodes.rationale: Live companies wiped to zero transactions but 'DO NOT switch on any Sage Sync yet'.

nodes.label: Joburg holding tier (JHBM) + Online sells straight from Main Distribution
Opening qty follows the item category
nodes.rationale: Import company is now always Ardmore (not a Sage company), so the qty would have gone nowhere; master goes to all three, qty only to the category's company.

nodes.label: Sage posting rule 14 Oct: multi-entity sale posts whole to Home (superseded)
nodes.rationale: On-site decision: one entity on the sale -> that entity, more than one -> Home, Ardmore sorts the inter-entity split internally.

nodes.label: Store-owner routing replaces category routing (2026-10-22)
nodes.rationale: With category routing a store's daily takings split across three Sage companies while the money hit one bank account, and Home had already bought the stock intercompany.

nodes.label: QOH sync sums the three Sage companies
nodes.rationale: With all three integrations on Main Distribution the last company to run won per item and could zero another company's piece.

nodes.label: Account Sales post to the customer's own Sage account
nodes.rationale: is_pos = till sale against the cash customer; any other Sales Invoice is an Account Sale against the stockist's own Sage account.

nodes.label: Payment weakness: no receipt sent to Sage
nodes.rationale: Sage gets invoices with amountDue = total, so finance allocates the card settlement by hand; Phase 2 = post a customer receipt per invoice.

nodes.label: History route: pull from Sage through Pharoh
nodes.rationale: Spreadsheets were dirty (duplicates, free-text codes); Sage is the source, about 6 months a call, 2 years back; spreadsheets are the fallback.

nodes.label: Item master backfill through the existing item sync
nodes.rationale: The sync only ever pulled items with stock, so sold ceramics never arrived and 3,242 Sales History lines had no item code; no new code path.

nodes.label: UAT cut to 100 SKUs on POS_Test2 against Sage TEST
nodes.rationale: 6,000 products was proving troublesome, so isolate 100 with images and real prices, all mapped to the Sage TEST company.

nodes.label: Whole numbers unless Meter
nodes.rationale: Rule is a DECIMAL_UNITS constant, not a UOM lookup, because cashier roles may lack read on UOM; UOM each has Must be Whole Number as backstop.

nodes.label: 177 fabric items moved to Meter
nodes.rationale: ERPNext refuses to change stock_uom once Stock Ledger Entries exist, so a temp script wrote Item, UOM Conversion Detail, Bin and SLE directly.

nodes.label: Every till offers exactly Credit Card + Voucher (Cash and EFT removed)
8-digit sequential POS barcodes
nodes.rationale: Item codes are unusable as barcodes (a 40mm label at 203 dpi holds 9 characters); an 8-digit number fits the existing 40x20 2-up labels.

nodes.label: Import rejects rows with values not on the allowed list
nodes.rationale: Russell chose the importer route over blanking the Select lists: do not import the line and show it as an error.

nodes.label: Client guides are instance data
nodes.rationale: Client documents are instance-specific, so they are uploaded as Files + a Web Page, not shipped in nest_help.

nodes.label: Report a Problem tile to Syncflo helpdesk
nodes.rationale: Slick fault/bug/improvement logging for go-live tracked on Syncflo's own helpdesk, with no second login for Ardmore staff.

nodes.label: Go-live target Monday 2 November 2026 + switch-on weekend plan
Final-test plan: option 1 (real tills on company Ardmore under the lock)
Interim add-locally stock mechanism
nodes.rationale: No qty-update endpoint exists, so sheet quantities for existing items are added by Material Receipt; remove once Pharoh's update endpoint lands.

nodes.label: Exact-match patcher via temporary API Server Script
nodes.rationale: Live scripts are patched by str.replace pairs with a dry run requiring each old string exactly once; Frappe compiles on save so a syntax error cannot land.

nodes.label: Sage item user fields: Sculptor / Thrower / Painter (+ rates)
Roles added to a User with a Role Profile are wiped
nodes.rationale: Adding a role to the user directly is overwritten by the profile on the next save; add it to the Role Profile.

nodes.label: v16 User role_profiles child table
nodes.rationale: Setting role_profile_name alone APPENDS a row and keeps the old roles; set the role_profiles table.

nodes.label: 'Price is not set for the item' (Online POS blocker)
allow_in_returns = 0 on POS payment modes blocks refunds
Insights fork telemetry ImportError aborts migrate
nodes.rationale: Old fork imported PostHog symbols removed from newer Frappe; ImportError during sync_all aborted the whole migrate and blocked ALL deploys.

nodes.label: QOH sync 1205 Lock wait timeout
nodes.rationale: Whole paginated Sage read ran in ONE transaction holding Item row locks; fixed with commit per page, recon chunk 25, per-batch retry.

nodes.label: Batch poisoning: one disabled item fails the whole batch
nodes.rationale: Stock Reconciliation / Material Receipt refuse disabled items, so one bad row failed 25 good ones; filter + per-item retry fallback.

nodes.label: Select-option landmines (values not in Item Select options block saves)
nodes.rationale: Sage/imports send values not in ERPNext Select options and the item refuses to save; sweep each Select with a 'not in options' filter after bulk imports.

nodes.label: Select first-option default on new records
nodes.rationale: Frappe fills a Select on a new record with its FIRST option unless the list starts with a blank line.

nodes.label: standard_rate writes to disabled Standard Selling
nodes.rationale: Setting Item.standard_rate makes ERPNext write an Item Price on the disabled default list; do NOT enable Standard Selling, keep standard_rate empty.

nodes.label: Sheet qty only honoured for a brand-new item
nodes.rationale: post_new_item_to_sage is an After Insert hook that fires once; on an existing item the qty lands in custom_opening_qty and is silently ignored.

nodes.label: post-new-item-to-sage creates a duplicate for an existing item
nodes.rationale: Proven by controlled probe: the endpoint always inserts, it is not an upsert by Code; never use it to update quantities.

nodes.label: Sage inventory sync wiped custom_size
nodes.rationale: item_doc.custom_size = None was an old workaround for Select-validation errors; removed and commented 'do not reintroduce'.

nodes.label: Lesson: saving a Server Script proves nothing - execute it once against real data
POS rebuilds its components on re-entry
nodes.rationale: The till creates new component instances each time the cashier re-enters, so patches must poll every 1 s and patch any unpatched instance.

nodes.label: POS payment amounts are entered cents-style
nodes.rationale: A document keydown listener feeds every keystroke to the selected payment mode; typing 4000 gives R40.00.

nodes.label: New API Server Script answers Failed to get method
nodes.rationale: The api-method map is cached; saving any Server Script (or recreating under a new name) makes the new one callable.

nodes.label: Frappe Cloud assets are cached immutable
nodes.rationale: /assets is served max-age=31536000 immutable, so static files linked from scripts need a ?v=<app version> query string.

nodes.label: Nest Home Tile naming series stuck on NEST-TILE-0001
nodes.rationale: Raw create of a tile collides; use build_profile_view with a dict spec or insert with set_name.

nodes.label: Private Files are listed only for their owner
Transaction Deletion Record unusable
nodes.rationale: It would delete Company Sage Integration (credentials) and Price Lists; wiped by a temp API script instead.

nodes.label: represents_company precedes company in DocField
nodes.rationale: The clean-up survey took the first company link only and missed PO/PR/PI/SO; filter DocField on fieldname = company explicitly.

nodes.label: Hand-written /app/ links break after framework update
nodes.rationale: The desk is /desk/ since Frappe 16.51; check Web Pages, tile routes and help pages.

nodes.label: Frappe print CSS forces td img width 100 percent
nodes.rationale: Item pictures in a table cell stretch, so use a fixed-size span with a background-image.

nodes.label: Insights v3 dashboard filter shape
nodes.rationale: A filter's linked query must be the chart's query or in its closure, so link every chart to the ONE source query.

nodes.label: frappe.make_post_request is a Server Script sandbox alias
nodes.rationale: It does not exist in app code; import make_post_request from frappe.integrations.utils.

nodes.label: A session-local watcher is not a scheduler
Item sync failed silently since 5 Oct
nodes.rationale: Stock Settings default warehouse still pointed at the training company, and new_doc pre-filled Category with Ceramics so the own-company rule skipped item_group.

nodes.label: 28,224 Customers = 1,802 names (Paul's nightly duplicate inserts)
nodes.rationale: The sync filtered on a Customer field 'company' that does not exist, never found what it made and inserted the whole list again every night.

nodes.label: Scheduler Event script traps
nodes.rationale: Enabling a script with next_execution in the past fires it at once; a script disabling itself does not stop its Scheduled Job Type (set stopped = 1).

nodes.label: Entity wholesale lists are VAT-inclusive
nodes.rationale: The price sync multiplies Sage's exclusive figure by 1.15, so the intercompany script divides by 1.15 before the discount.

nodes.label: Sage rebuilt R150 as 149.99
nodes.rationale: Sage rebuilt the total from the rounded exclusive line, so sales and returns are now sent as INCLUSIVE documents.

nodes.label: v16 link validation honours the POS Profile customer-group filter
nodes.rationale: Till-created customers had no group and failed 'does not match'; POS Customer UX now sets customer_group = Cash.

nodes.label: Till scripts run as one concatenated block
nodes.rationale: A new till script must start with ;(function and wrap its body in try/catch, and be created disabled then checksum-verified.

nodes.label: Helpdesk merge_ticket fails over the API
Custom DocPerm replaces the standard permissions
Gotcha: Frappe Webhook headers are not Jinja-rendered
nodes.rationale: A Jinja expression in a header is sent literally (403), so the API key stays plaintext in the Webhook Header row.
